title: F2FS (Flash-Friendly File System) signature
summary: F2FS superblock is at byte offset 1024. The magic number is 0xF2F52010 at offset 0 of the superblock (byte offset 1024).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: F2FS is designed for NAND flash storage (SSDs, eMMC, SD cards).
F2FS uses a log-structured approach with a node address table (NAT) and segment information table (SIT).
F2FS is the default filesystem on Android and is used in many embedded Linux systems.
F2FS supports compression (LZO, LZ4, zstd) and encryption.
